investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on the Italian domain vitali-pharmacy.it, shown on a page with a standard contact form. The domain resolves to a Cloudflare CDN IP and is 8 years old with NameCheap, Inc. as registrar, indicating an established web presence. No recent similar alerts were found and there is no clear evidence of credential harvesting on the page, suggesting a lower likelihood of active impersonation at this time, though monitoring should continue.
